scripts.format: pnpm --recursive format && pnpm --dir apps/web exec oxfmt --write "$PWD/scripts"
scripts.format:check: pnpm --recursive format:check && pnpm --dir apps/web exec oxfmt --check "$PWD/scripts"
scripts.lint: pnpm --recursive lint && pnpm --dir apps/web exec oxlint --config "$PWD/apps/web/.oxlintrc.json" --deny-warnings "$PWD/scripts"
